meta.name: The Aam Aadmi Family Season 3
meta.description:
This show revolves around a middle-class Sharma family. There's a gossip-loving grandmother, a hardworking father, a sanskaari mom, and two grown up kids who are dealing with their middle-classness in the best way possible.

Not complete. On your server: S1 not on server | S2 not on server | S3 5/5 | S4 not on server

videos.title: Mera Damaad
videos.overview: Sonu and Sarthak come home. Mr Sharma has still not accepted Sarthak as his son-in-law. The electricity goes off when Sarthak tries to have a conversation with him. Will Mr Sharma ever like Sarthak?

videos.title: Chalti Ka Naam Gaadi
videos.overview: Mr Sharma is looking for his scooter keys. Mrs Sharma and Bobby are acting weird and do not want him to find the keys. What happens next?

videos.title: Aaj Ki Taaza Khabar
videos.overview: Sonu wants to pursue MBA from a college in another town. Will her in-laws object, or will Sonu be able to follow her dreams?

videos.title: Mother India
videos.overview: Sattu and his younger brother have a long-time feud. One day, the doorbell rings, and Sattu finds Jazzy Chachu at the doorstep. Will the brothers resolve their issues?

videos.title: Maa
videos.overview: It is Daadi's birthday, and the Sharma family is throwing a huge party for her. But will the celebrations go as planned?
